name: QR Generator
description: Create custom QR codes instantly. Generate codes for URLs, text, WiFi, contacts, and more with design options.
longDescription: QR Generator lets you create professional QR codes in seconds. Customize colors, add logos, choose from multiple data types (URLs, vCard, WiFi, plain text, SMS, email). High-resolution PNG and SVG exports. Track scans with built-in analytics on paid plans.
pricingDetails: Free tier: unlimited static QR codes. Pro: $7.50/month for dynamic codes, analytics, bulk generation, API access.
features: Multiple data types (URL, vCard, WiFi, SMS, Email)
